title: AgentCARD FinanceBench external prompt-scaffold control

external_prompt_source.adaptation: StructuredChatAgent textual JSON tool-call serialization is omitted because the runner supplies tool schemas through native function calling. The task-to-plan and plan-to-executor message boundaries are unchanged across all arms.

analysis.primary: For each scaffold, report the paired strong-planner minus strong-executor accuracy difference on all 30 tasks.
analysis.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap 95% percentile interval with fixed seeds; also report the paired 2x2 transition counts and exact McNemar p-value.
analysis.prompt_effect: For each model direction, report external-scaffold minus original accuracy on the same 30 task IDs.
analysis.reporting: Report all four arms and all 120 task outcomes. Do not select a scaffold, task subset, seed, or rerun based on direction or significance.

stopping_rule: Stop after exactly the four declared arms complete. Do not add prompt variants after viewing outcomes.

pilot_disposition.status: retained as response-period pilot artifact but excluded from the primary external-scaffold table
pilot_disposition.design_reason: The handwritten intervention simultaneously weakened exact-tool and zero-judgment constraints, removed explicit discovery rules, and added executor adaptation behavior; it is not a strict meaning-preserving prompt control.
